### Phase 1: Buddy Allocator Data Abort — FIXED (committed `d9dde9c7`)
- Kernel boots to `/ #` shell prompt on RPi3 hardware
- 4/4 CPUs online
- All SMP bringup working

### Phase 2: Shell Interactive stdin/stdout — FIXED (committed `381202a8`)
- `echo hello` returns `hello` — shell IS interactive
- Init process exits after /init script completes (normal busybox sh behavior)
- `exit_qemu()` called after init process exit

## Root Cause (Phase 2)
`create_init_task` tried to open `/dev/console` before `device::init_in_first_process` created the device node. The initramfs `/dev/` is empty — `/dev/console` is only created by device init which runs AFTER `spawn_init_process`.

## Fix Applied (Phase 2)
Removed manual stdin/stdout/stderr setup from `create_init_task` in `kernel/src/process/process/init_proc.rs`. The `init_in_first_process` function properly sets up the file table when the init task first runs.

## Current State
- RPi3 is powered ON

- Init process ran busybox sh /init successfully and exited
- Kernel is likely in halted CPU loop (exit_qemu path)
- Serial connection: still open
